scope_rationale: The existing leaf already owns fragmentation design; this refinement adds six explicit assessed mechanisms and a required executable exercise instead of creating a duplicate global leaf or rewriting accepted taxonomy.

competencies.title: Identity and admission
competencies.outcome: Keep full datagram identity, checked offsets, first header and protocol separation.

competencies.title: Complete coverage
competencies.outcome: Prove coverage and final-length invariants; reject gaps and inconsistent ends.

competencies.title: Overlap policy
competencies.outcome: Implement strict and identical-byte overlap, atomic conflict retirement and bounded tombstones.

competencies.title: Resource ownership
competencies.outcome: Derive fixed capacity, READY ownership, refused admission, exact release and costs.

competencies.title: Expiry and feedback
competencies.outcome: Implement absolute timeout, backward/overflow rejection and first-header Time Exceeded reporting with suppression premises.

competencies.title: Changed-condition integration
competencies.outcome: Compose actual original checksum and IP/Echo parser, then transfer with one slot and changed overlap policy.
